column1: # Wave 23 (W23-10 / audit A-5): the INDEPENDENT ribbon pin.
# loaded capture for the Task tab) BEFORE seeing the gate's old pinned list.
# The gate parses THIS file; it no longer carries a second copy of the table.
# The `enabled` column is the port's decision-9 set (which commands are really
# implemented), pinned by name and counted -- not "enabled iff implemented".
# Format: tab, contextual(0/1), group, kind, label, enabled(0/1), icon key.
# A `group` row opens a group; following `button` rows are its controls in
# order.  Icon-only buttons, combos, checkboxes, the gallery and dialog
# launchers are NOT modelled yet (W23-15 / B-6); they are listed in
# app_qt/ribbon_pin_unmodelled.tsv so the backlog is explicit.
